algorithm.multi_terminal_policy: rectilinear MST / nearest connected tree; each branch uses net-wide Hanan lanes plus A* fallback
algorithm.wire_collision_policy: wire-wire crossings are allowed; existing wire grid cells are congestion hints, not hard obstacles
algorithm.pin_collision_policy: exact pin cells are reserved so routes do not pass through other nets' pins
algorithm.failure_policy: wire mode records unroutable nets as failures; terminal/combination mode may convert selected failures to local-label terminal plans
algorithm.pin_point_policy: uses placement.pin_points when supplied; otherwise estimates endpoint stubs from component body edges
